blocks.text: I've been market making on @arcus_xyz for a while now, and the setup I use today needs almost no input from me. I hire one @tread_fi agent, answer four questions, and the bot handles the rest — scanning the regime, running when conditions are good, pausing when they're not.
This is the full walkthrough.
Step 1 — Get both accounts
You need a @tread_fi account and an @arcus_xyz account. Arcus is invite only for now, but using my ref link, you can skip the invite code. My refs are auto eligible for signup without a access code.

Tread: https://app.tread.fi/referral/59S1TB1X
Arcus: https://app.arcus.xyz/ref/NOORUCN

Fund the Arcus account with at least $20. That's the floor to run anything meaningful. More on sizing later.

Here's some codes if arcus still asking for codes. 
BJW3VQ
9COTQ5
P4DBY4
GQACJI
KTW59B
O9YNWZ
Step 2 — Connect Arcus to Tread
On Tread, click the wallet icon in the top right of the menu.
On the next screen, look at the bottom left and click "Connect perp dex account". Pick Arcus, hit "Connect", then "Submit".
That's it. Your Arcus account is now wired into Tread.
Step 3 — Pick how you want to run the bot
Two routes from here.

The manual route is https://app.tread.fi/volume_bot, where you choose the bot mode and the settings yourself. If you don't know how each mode behaves, I wrote out all of them here: https://treadfiacademy--sportytechworld.replit.app/modes/dn-bot
The other route is agents — you let an AI agent find the settings and run the bot for you. That's what I use, and that's what the rest of this covers.
Using my custom agent
I built a market making agent and listed it on the Tread marketplace. It's free to hire. Once it's running you don't touch anything.
First, whitelist your Arcus account for agents.
Go to https://app.tread.fi/agents/settings/access
Hover over your Arcus account and click "+ Whitelist". It moves to the Whitelist tab.
From there, make sure you tick Trade — this is the part people miss, without it the agent can't actually place orders. Then click Save.
Second, hire the agent.
My listing is "Nooru's Market Maker Bot": https://app.tread.fi/agents/marketplace/60164439dbd7431a84f610ede6130ec3
Click "Hire agent". Done.
Third, run it.
Go to https://app.tread.fi/agents and open any of your projects. No project yet? Click "+" and start one.
Inside the project, click "Start a session". You'll see every agent you have available. Pick "Nooru's Market Maker Bot".
Now you get a prompt box with three default prompts. For this, click "Setup a market making bot on given exchange".
It'll show you the available exchanges. Click Arcus. If Arcus isn't in the list, type it into the "Others" field. Continue.
Pick your pair. The agent pulls the top 5 pairs on Arcus by volume. MM bots need volume to work with, so I always take the highest one on that list. Continue.
Set your margin. This is the only number that really matters, so read this part properly.
If you have $100 sitting in your Arcus account, don't allocate more than $50 here. Keep buffer.
How the sizing works: margin × leverage × 10 = target volume for that round. So $50 margin at 15x leverage means the bot is aiming for roughly $7,500 of volume in that round.
Pick your strategy mode. Three options:

A — ⚡ Fast Volume + Consistent PnL — Mid bot, -1 spread. [my recommendation] 
B — 🐢 Slow PnL-Focused — Grid bot, +1 spread, 0.05% reset 
C — 🔬 Strict Regime Check — Grid bot, +1 spread, 0.125% reset
If you just want volume at a predictable cost per million, take A. That's the one I run most of the time.
B is aimed at better PnL, but the CPM swings. Some rounds come out great, some don't, and it varies a lot by exchange. You'd have to run a few rounds on Arcus yourself to see where it lands for you.

C adds a higher-timeframe filter that keeps the bot out of trending markets and only lets it work in ranging conditions. Best CPM of the three on paper. The tradeoff is real though — the bot can sit stalled for a long time waiting for a clean environment, so you make less volume overall.
Pick one and continue. You'll get a confirmation card with your full config. Click "Start Nooru's Market Maker Bot".
NOT SURE WHICH OPTION? RUN AN A/B/C TEST
Paste this into a fresh session on the same agent. Replace account name, margin and leverage with your own.

Set up a market-making strategy on Arcus pairs on Arcus account. Account: [your account name]. Pair: "pair name". Margin: $100. Leverage: 10x.   Run a sequential CPM comparison across 3 configs, looping for 7 days:
Option 1 — Mid bot, -1 spread, 5% SL/TP, aggressive POV. IST time windows only: 08:00–12:00, 14:00–17:30, 22:00–01:00. Gates: ADX < 30 on 1m + 5m. Run this first.
Option 4 — Same as Option 1 but runs 24/7, no time gate. Gates: ADX < 30 on 1m + 5m AND 5m RSI within 35–65. Activate when Option 1 is time-gated out OR after an Option 1 SL hit.
Option 2 — Grid bot, +1 spread, 0.05% grid reset, 5% SL/TP, passive POV. IST time windows only (same as Option 1). Same ADX gates.

Rotation order: Option 1 → Option 4 (gap-fill / post-SL) → Option 2 in eligible windows → loop. Flatten and cancel ALL orders immediately when conditions are not met — no residue. Track CPM per run to identify best conditions.

What happens after that
The agent scans the regime, runs market making on Arcus when conditions are favourable, pauses when they aren't, and repeats. You don't need to do anything.
Two things you should do:

Check on it now and then. There can be bugs from AI downtime, and if it stalls you can just ask the agent what's going wrong — it'll tell you. Watch your margin. These are repetitive bots and the balance grinds down over rounds. Top it up so the bot keeps running instead of dying halfway.
The other way — supervisor agent
If you'd rather not use my agent, go to "Start session" and pick the supervisor agent instead.
Ask it to run an MM bot on Arcus with the best settings for cost. It'll hand you a config you can go and start the bot with.
Up to you which one you take.
